vehicleUpdates.headline: Three-across shown in Earth; Air trial still needed
vehicleUpdates.summary: Air offers a flat floor and rear pillar vents. Related Earth testing squeezed three restraints in and gave a 180 cm driver space ahead of a rear-facing seat; exact Air mixed fit and booster buckling need a trial.

familyFit.summary: Related Earth demonstrated a very tight three-across fit, photographed forward-facing. The requested one rear-facing plus two-seat/booster mix is not established; family-fit scoring is withheld.
familyFit.row2: Three top tethers on rear seatbacks; ISOFIX at the two outer positions only. Centre uses the seatbelt, not borrowed outer ISOFIX anchors.
familyFit.row3: Five seats only; no third row.
familyFit.testedSeats: 2025 Earth AWD Long Range: three child restraints fitted, described as very tight. Article does not name the restraints or specify the full facing/booster mix. Separate rear-facing clearance test is documented; exact one rear-facing plus two forward-facing/booster setup is not confirmed.
familyFit.buckleAccess: Three-booster daily buckle access is unknown. ANCAP tested each restraint separately, not three together.
familyFit.access: Related Earth test praises flat-floor foot space and getting in/out; Air door opening and loading with your restraints need a physical trial.
familyFit.ventilation: MY25/MY26 Air: rear door-pillar air vents and two USB-C outlets behind the front seats.

safety.applicability: ANCAP covers all variants built April 2024 onward, on sale Australia October 2024 onward. Report identifies a Type A capsule seatbelt-installation problem at outer rear positions; separate-position checks do not prove three-across.

vehicleUpdates.servicing: 12 months/15,000 km. MY25 manual: low-conductivity coolant every 36 months/60,000 km; brake fluid every 24 months/30,000 km. Request due-service and plan-transfer records.
pros: Rear pillar vents, flat floor and practical storage.
Air uses 18-inch tyres; budget aftermarket replacement prices are shown in ownership costs.
cons: Related Earth three-across trial was at the seat-base limit; booster buckles remain untested.
Air lacks Earth power tailgate; no spare wheel or GT-Line surround-view camera.
inspection: Install all three actual restraints in the Air; check harness access, belt routing, door closure and booster buckles with children seated.
Check low-conductivity coolant at 36 months/60,000 km and brake-fluid records; ask for the next service cost in writing.
Confirm first-registration date, private/fleet/rental history, prepaid plan and kilometre-limited HV cover; inspect the battery underside and complete both AC and DC charge tests.
Ask Kia to check VIN campaigns, software version, fault history and 12V battery health. A generic EV-system warning is not a diagnosis.

changes.text: Original Australian MY25 dealer-hosted Kia specification matches current MY26 Air battery, range, consumption, AC and 10–80% charging claims. Overseas Korean/European EV5 packs and equipment are different; do not substitute.

gaps: Exact Air combination of one rear-facing plus two forward-facing seats/boosters and daily buckle access is unverified; related Earth fit is constrained evidence, not a documented mixed-setup failure.
Peak DC kW is not stated in matched Australian maker PDFs; independent launch reports 102 kW SR / about 140 kW LR, but numeric field remains unverified.
No representative Australian long-term EV5 paid-repair dataset or installed traction-pack quote found.

battery.basis: Published LFP pack energy; gross/usable split not stated

acCharging.basis: On-board maximum: single-phase SR; three-phase LR. Matching MY25 and MY26 maker specifications.

boot.basis: VDA rear luggage, rear seats up; excludes 67 L front storage

bootAllRows.basis: VDA rear luggage, rear seats up; excludes 67 L front storage

towing.basis: Braked rating, matching Australian MY25/MY26 specification; SR 300 kg versus LR 1,250 kg. Towball download 50 kg; account for occupants and luggage.

consumption.basis: Australian MY25 and MY26 WLTP combined, converted from Wh/km; regulated recharge-energy figure, not a road test

vehicleUpdates.chargeTime: Maker MY25/MY26: 10–80% approximately 36 min on suitable 350 kW infrastructure; 57 min on 50 kW. AC 10–100% approximately 9 h 43 min on suitable 7 kW supply; car limited to 6.6 kW. Times depend on temperature, state of charge and charger output; 350 kW is infrastructure rating, not vehicle intake.

Prior QLD stock 70029 excluded because cached seller page shows A$43,990 EGC while earlier fresh direct HTML showed A$42,990; fresh direct recheck unavailable. No new/demo or sold entries mixed in. Not completed-sale evidence.
priceUpdates.estimateBasis: Arithmetic median of two included advertised prices, A$41,494.50; thin interstate sample is not a valuation or delivered Queensland quote.

observations.note: Exact MY25 Air Standard Range, seller says ex-Kia Australia ownership. Individual ad A$42,999 excludes charges supersedes category A$43,888. Freight/QLD costs extra; not combined with demos/new orders.

observations.note: Distinct stock 37859, Shale Grey MY25 Air Standard Range; 64.2 kWh / 400 km configuration, dealer used. priceUpdates.kilometres: 46,052–54,960 km; exact configuration examples detailed below

ownershipUpdates.serviceInterval: 12 months / 15,000 km, whichever first. MY25 manual adds low-conductivity coolant every 36 months / 60,000 km and AU/NZ brake fluid every 24 months / 30,000 km; severe-use extras apply.
ownershipUpdates.serviceBasis: ESTIMATE retained A$450/year (A$350–550) for used Air pay-as-you-go budgeting. Current GST-inclusive maker prepaid plans: 3 services A$1,185, 5 A$1,839, 7 A$2,892 (A$413/year over seven annual visits). These are package prices, not individual fixed service quotes. Plans include standard scheduled fluids/labour; confirm coolant inclusion and the VIN schedule. New enrolment requires under 11 months / 15,000 km and no prior scheduled service; attached plans stay with the car. Tyres, faults and severe-use extras excluded.
warrantyCautions: Private-use vehicle warranty is transferable for 7 years/unlimited km, subject to original terms. Any prior commercial use can impose 150,000 km limit; inspect usage and service records, not only age.

Pre-MY27 HV battery retention is 7 years/150,000 km to at least 70%; not the newer 8-year/160,000-km promise. HV motor/on-board charger/control components separately have 7-year/150,000-km defect cover.
12V battery: 2 years; AV/AVN head unit: 3 years/unlimited km. A headline seven-year warranty does not extend these terms. Normal wear, accident damage and scheduled maintenance are excluded.

Official VIN-applicable cluster recall has a free remedy. Owner reports below establish inspection questions, not rates of failure or annual paid repair costs. Confirm earliest warranty commencement date and any written-off history.

risks.title: Full traction-battery replacement — stress case
risks.detail: Budget for a complete pack only if diagnosis supports replacement. A module, control-system or drive-unit-only repair can be substantially cheaper; this range does not predict failure.
risks.priceBasis: ESTIMATE: model-specific Australian quote unavailable; based on the Insurance Council’s 2024 A$7,500–30,000 benchmark (itself converted from US research, not Australian installed invoices) and a broker’s A$10,000–30,000+ general guide, adjusted for the family’s 64.2–88.1 kWh packs; upper end includes a larger-pack allowance. Full replacement planning total assumes parts, labour and GST; not a hard ceiling or a priced repair offer.
risks.warranty: Pre-MY2027 capacity promise: 7 years / 150,000 km, at least 70%.

risks.title: Shorter auxiliary-battery cover
risks.detail: The 12V battery has shorter cover than the traction battery and can become an owner-paid maintenance item.
risks.priceBasis: ESTIMATE: EV5-specific installed quote unavailable; based on NRMA’s SUV battery service starting at A$249 member / A$339 non-member incl. delivery/installation, widened for correct EV battery specification and workshop fitment. Assumes GST; not a fitment guarantee. NRMA’s published offer is for ordinary SUV auxiliary batteries in NSW/ACT; Queensland availability and the specific EV battery/fitment are not established by that class price.
risks.warranty: Auxiliary-battery cover is 2 years, subject to terms.

risks.title: Conventional suspension repair example — one axle
risks.detail: A worn damper/strut pair is a paid-work example outside ordinary scheduled servicing. Structural accident damage needs a separate estimate; this does not establish an EV5 failure pattern.
risks.priceBasis: ESTIMATE: EV5-specific quote unavailable; Australian conventional front-damper pair guidance is A$650–1,300. Widened for vehicle weight, OEM parts, mounts and alignment. Assumes parts, labour and GST; excludes tyres and collision reconstruction.
risks.warranty: Vehicle cover and prepaid services both have wear / damage exclusions.

risks.title: Selected 2025 VINs — March 2026 instrument-cluster recall
risks.detail: REC-006557, published 6 March 2026, includes selected 2025 EV5 VINs and other Kia models. Cluster software can cause blank/slow display. The free update is VIN-specific, not evidence every grouped year is affected.
risks.priceBasis: A$0 for the official VIN-applicable recall remedy. This is rectification of an identified campaign, not a future owner-paid replacement quote.
risks.warranty: Check the VIN and campaign completion with the Australian manufacturer; official recall rectification is separate from ordinary warranty expiry.

risks.title: Reported EV-system warnings — diagnosis and warranty history
risks.detail: One Australian first-person post reports roadside diagnosis/replacement of a 12V battery; another comment reports front-motor replacement pending. A separate thread has an Australian commenter reporting an HV pack replaced under warranty in three weeks; its main Canadian case is not Australian evidence. These unverified anecdotes show different possible causes and downtime, not incidence, cost averages or an EV6-style ICCU fault rate.
risks.priceBasis: No Australian EV5 installed paid invoice or representative annual repair average verified. Do not infer an out-of-pocket pack price from warranty replacement anecdotes. Existing A$650 annual fund remains an explicitly low-confidence savings allowance.
risks.warranty: Ask for Kia diagnostic/service records, HV warranty balance and loan-car arrangements; claimed covered remedies are not owner-paid repairs.

expertReviews.tested: 2024 Kia EV5 Air Long Range, Australian MY25 local launch
expertReviews.scope: Southern Highlands NSW launch, 30 October 2024. Published 78/100 converted arithmetically to 7.8/10. Historical launch pricing is not current used-market evidence; SR was driven back-to-back but the headline scored configuration is LR.
expertReviews.verdict: 78/100: spacious family EV; moderate charging and front-drive traction compromises.
positiveThemes: Good passenger space and immediate electric response.
Practical boot and familiar cabin controls.
negativeThemes: Base Air equipment omissions and modest DC charging.
Front-wheel torque steer and traction limits under hard acceleration.

insuranceUpdates.basis: A$1,920/year retained, rounded from Compare the Market March 2026 EV5 Standard Range quote average A$1,921: 34-year-old male in Alderley Brisbane, garaged, clean history, up to 15,000 km, market value, targeted A$900 excess. A$1,300–3,000 bounds are assumptions, not study quantiles. Youi national mixed-customer EV5 average A$1,765 is a different population; do not blend. Air LR and this household need actual quotes.

tyreUpdates.basis: Budget aftermarket anchor: Radar RPX800+ SUV 104W XL, A$189 each × 4 = A$756 fitted. Ordinary JAX advertised price includes fitting, balancing, tubeless valves, disposal, selected-store delivery and GST; no temporary multi-buy discount used. Store stock and Brisbane availability are unconfirmed. Life is a common 40,000 km planning assumption (25,000–60,000 km sensitivity), not a measured model or tyre average. Wear varies with tyre choice, driving, maintenance and vehicle; model-specific replacement averages were not verified. Annual allowance = set budget × annual km ÷ 40,000, rounded to A$10. Age/damage can require earlier replacement. Alignment is additional; actual placard, wheel package and local fitted quote must be checked. Matching size/load/speed does not establish equal braking, efficiency or durability.

audit.summary: MY25 maker PDF closes year-applicability gaps; related Earth test supports constrained three-across evidence, with booster buckles unknown. Added maintenance-fluid schedule, exact LR observed consumption and scored launch review. Six clean asks rechecked; conflicting QLD SR observation excluded. Repair and owner reliability evidence remain thin.

items.finding: SR refreshed to two verified interstate asks A$39,990–42,999 EGC, median A$41,494.50; QLD stock 70029 excluded for A$42,990/43,990 cached/direct conflict. LR four distinct QLD asks A$42,490–42,990 drive-away and 46,052–54,960 km unchanged. Confirm renewed registration and freight. New/demo October A$2,000 cashback is separate and cannot combine with promoted finance.

Original MY25 PDF matches MY26 Air: 64.2/88.1 kWh LFP, FWD; WLTP 400/555 km and 18.2/18.0 kWh/100 km. AC maxima 6.6/11 kW and DC 10–80% 36/38 min. LR road-test indicated 16.7 is separate from lab wall energy; projected >520 km is not a measured depleted range. Peak DC maker figure still missing.

Three restraints were demonstrated only in related Earth, with a tight bench. Air has two outer ISOFIX/three rear tethers and pillar vents. ANCAP identifies outer seatbelt-fitted Type A capsule restriction and tests restraints separately. Three-booster buckles and exact Air combinations remain unknown. Facing-photo recheck: the requested one rear-facing plus two-seat/booster mix is not established, so no family-fit score is assigned.

Original/pre-MY27 terms preserved: private vehicle 7 years/unlimited km; HV components and battery 7 years/150,000 km, battery to 70%. Transferable subject to terms; commercial use, 2-year 12V and 3-year AV/AVN exceptions matter on used stock.

A$450/year used-Air budget retained; maker Air prepaid 3/5/7 plans A$1,185/1,839/2,892 include GST. Manual identifies low-conductivity coolant 36 months/60,000 km and AU/NZ brake fluid 24 months/30,000 km. Used car may only inherit an existing plan; individual next-service quote missing.

A$1,920/year retained from A$1,921 model-specific March 2026 Brisbane study profile; Youi EV5 national mean A$1,765 is a different customer pool. Assumed bounds are not percentiles; LR and household-specific quotes absent.

Budget aftermarket audit, 18 October 2026. 225/60R18 104W XL replacement reference: A$756 for four fitted. Common 40,000 km life is an illustrative assumption, not model-specific wear evidence. Prices and annual savings are estimates; check the real placard and local fitted quote.

Official REC-006557 applies to selected 2025 VINs; free cluster software update, published March 2026. AU first-person 12V/motor/HV anecdotes provide no paid invoice or denominator. No empirical annual EV5 paid-repair rate found: retain A$650 savings reserve as low-confidence, not an average or proof of better reliability.

ProductReview remains 5/5 from one GT-Line delivery/dealer review, not Air reliability evidence. Air SR week test and Air LR launch/week tests are correctly separated. Added LR Carsales 78/100 normalised to 7.8/10; Earth/GT-Line ride complaints must not be applied wholesale to Air.

Towing differs sharply: SR 300 kg/50 kg towball; LR 1,250 kg/100 kg. No spare, manual Air tailgate. ANCAP all variants Apr-2024 onward. QLD electric rego+CTP currently A$782.15–798.15; future fees/depreciation unverified. Inspect due coolant, battery underside, VIN/software, AC/DC and prior fleet history.
